method: Repository source executed with offline dependency doubles

evidence.title: Paid cover entitlements cannot open the unified studio
evidence.detail: Four offers grant cover=true, but the only studio redirects to a feature they cannot access.

evidence.title: Unlimited failure refund adds credits without a debit
evidence.detail: Balance 100 -> 104 after reserve(4), failure, refund(4); spend_credits was never called.

evidence.title: Plan changes overwrite concurrent credit spending
evidence.detail: 100 - 10 concurrent spend + 120 plan credits should be 210; stored balance is 220.

evidence.title: Concurrent offer grants lose an entitlement
evidence.detail: Two successful concurrent grants leave only {"coloring":true,"cover":true,"ebook":true,"crossword":true,"activity":true}.

evidence.title: Offer delivery can fail after features have already unlocked
evidence.detail: Credit RPC fails after unlimited access is committed; request fails and no grant_offer history is written.

evidence.title: Factory and Autopilot paths bypass generation caps
evidence.detail: At a simulated 1,000 completed generations, coloring is blocked but factory/autopilot perform zero cap checks.

evidence.title: Autopilot ignores loss of the job attempt and keeps generating
evidence.detail: Despite 9 lost-attempt errors, all 3 books complete and consume 30 credits.

evidence.title: Unset Cover V2 concept count returns one instead of the declared default two
evidence.detail: With COVER_V2_CONCEPTS absent, Number("") is 0 and the default becomes 1 instead of DEFAULT_CONCEPTS=2.

evidence.title: Spelling verifier accepts incorrect or missing titles
evidence.detail: Title ART passes transcription SMART; a Hindi title passes unrelated English text.

evidence.title: Publish ZIP labels applied PNG artwork as cover.pdf
evidence.detail: The ZIP receives name=cover.pdf but its bytes start with the PNG signature, not %PDF.

evidence.title: Ebook page_count records chapter count instead of actual pages
evidence.detail: Three very long chapters are persisted as page_count=3, despite title/contents pages and flowing chapter pagination.

evidence.title: Support attachments have no way to open from either ticket page
evidence.detail: Both admin/user ticket pages use a shared thread that renders attachments only as non-clickable spans.

evidence.title: Concurrent first subscription requests fail on unique(user_id)
evidence.detail: Two concurrent initial requests: one succeeds, the other throws duplicate key instead of returning the same subscription.

evidence.title: Analytics failure refunds an already committed publishing package
evidence.detail: Package upsert succeeds, usage insert fails, response is 500 and the completed package gets fully refunded.

evidence.title: Admin create-user fails after an active auth account is already created
evidence.detail: Offer delivery fails after createUser succeeds; an active confirmed account remains although the API reports failure.

evidence.title: Queued generators still debit Unlimited customers
evidence.detail: An Unlimited subscription still passes p_credit_cost=4; the SQL RPC debits v_cost without checking unlimited.
